 Before their opening match against LYON at Worlds 2026, Hizto shared us his Jungler Power Rankings and his goals as he makes his second appearance.
 Image Credit: Riot Games/Hotspawn 
 Davide : This is your second Worlds.
 What does it mean to be back, and what did you learn from your previous experience that you can bring into this year’s tournament?
 Hizto : We’re going to show something entirely different this time. Our goal is to make the top 8.
 Davide : How have scrims been going?
 Has any team surprised you or made you think, “They’re different from what I expected”?
 Hizto : I think they’ve been fine. We’ve managed to beat an LCK team and a team from our own region.
 Davide : Is there a team you’d particularly like to face at Worlds?
 Hizto : T1 . I’m a huge fan of Oner, and I really want to play against him.
 Davide : Did you swap jerseys with Oner this time?
 Hizto : No, but I did get a picture with him.
 Davide : I feel like you’ve become more confident this year compared with last year.
 Do you notice that in the way you speak on camera, too? Has something changed for you?
 Hizto : We’re confident. We’re fully confident going into this Worlds. We’ve achieved our goal of beating an LEC team, and our next goal is to beat an LPL team.
 Davide : Didn’t you already beat an LPL team ( Top Esports at MSI )?
 Hizto : I want to beat even more LPL teams, especially IG.
 TSW Hizto Jungle Power Rankings
 Hizto : Number one is Oner. Of course it has to be him. Then Canyon. ( proceeds to rank everyone else )
 Davide : Tarzan is above Wei? Most people, especially in the West, consider him the number one jungler . Why do you have him at number seven?
 Hizto : Yes. I have Tarzan at number seven. I think Oner is going to be really strong at this Worlds.
 Davide : Your first match is against LYON, and you’ll be facing Inspired in the jungle.
 What do you think will be the key to beating them?
 Hizto : We can’t fall behind in the jungle-mid matchup. We need to build synergy there and snowball the game.
 Davide : Any last message for the fans?
 Hizto: I hope you’ll keep supporting us at Worlds and believe that we can make the top eight.
